verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage documents its own background automation. Agentic workflows include a Customer Screening and Ongoing Monitoring agent and a Transaction Monitoring agent that auto-remediate level 1 alerts and escalate high-risk cases to humans, and ongoing monitoring can be configured per customer, with WORKFLOW_COMPLETED webhooks reporting outcomes. However, the agent evidence is marketing-level and thin, and Starter Plan agent configurations cannot be customized, so user-defined automation setup is limited. Missing for 10: a user-configurable automation/rule builder, detailed docs on how agents are set up and scheduled, and independent or hands-on corroboration that the agents run autonomously as claimed.
